errors.text_span: The chart consists of a concentric, dual-ring pie chart with a total of nine slices representing different categories.
errors.evidence: The figure is a nested donut chart with 4 outer-ring slices and 3 inner-ring slices, for a total of 7 slices, not 9.

errors.text_span: The outer ring contains four slices, labeled “Std: 0.0” (dark blue, 7.0%), “Std: 0.47” (blue, 47.7%), “Std: 0.82” (light blue, 49.0%), and “Std: 0.94” (bright blue, 5.0%).
errors.evidence: The percentage-to-label/color mapping for the outer ring is incorrect: the 49.0% slice is dark blue and corresponds to Std: 0.0, while the 47.7% slice is the lighter blue corresponding to Std: 0.47. The 5.0% and 7.0% slices are also associated with different colors than stated.

errors.text_span: The inner ring contains three slices, labeled “Max: 1” (light teal, 14.2%), “Max: 2” (teal, 39.0%), and “Max: 3” (dark teal, 38.0%).
errors.evidence: The inner-ring color mapping is incorrect. In the figure, Max: 1 is the brightest/lightest blue at 39.0%, Max: 2 is the medium light blue at 47.7%, and Max: 3 is the palest blue at 14.2%.

errors.text_span: The slices appear to be ordered by descending proportion within each ring, starting with the largest slice and moving clockwise.
errors.evidence: The slices are not ordered in descending size within the rings; the outer ring and inner ring both show a non-monotonic arrangement of slice sizes around the circle.
